title: Basalt bas-relief carrying hermetic teachings
summary: Matt tells of Basalt bas-relief carrying hermetic teachings, about ancient at Lake Van region, Turkey, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you is a giant Basalt what's called a b relief and it is this massive 3ot by 3ot by 4ot stone column uh block that has all these sacred teachings that literally became what I think is the basis of hermeticism itself

plain: A researcher known as Matt, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2024, describes a giant basalt block in the Lake Van region of Turkey, about 3 by 3 by 4 feet. It is carved in raised figures, which is called a bas-relief. He says it carries sacred teachings that he thinks became the basis of Hermeticism, an old mystical tradition, which would put that tradition's roots in this region.
